Demo Insurance General Conditions for Health Insurance
Article 1. Preliminary
This contract is governed by the policy schedule and general conditions issued by Demo Insurance. The
documentation is synthetic and is used for a customer service prototype.
This article must be interpreted together with the policy schedule and issued annexes.
Support phones and deadlines are listed in the claims procedure for the line.
Synthetic document for a prototype · fictitious data · p. 1 of 11

Demo Insurance General Conditions for Health Insurance
Article 2. Definitions
Policyholder, insured, beneficiary, premium, claim, copay, deductible and waiting period have the meanings
described in these conditions.
This article must be interpreted together with the policy schedule and issued annexes.
Support phones and deadlines are listed in the claims procedure for the line.
Synthetic document for a prototype · fictitious data · p. 2 of 11

Demo Insurance General Conditions for Health Insurance
Article 3. Purpose of the insurance
The Health insurance covers the risks expressly included for each contracted plan.
This article must be interpreted together with the policy schedule and issued annexes.
Support phones and deadlines are listed in the claims procedure for the line.
Synthetic document for a prototype · fictitious data · p. 3 of 11

Demo Insurance General Conditions for Health Insurance
Article 4. Coverage by plan
The available plans are: Health Essential, Health Complete, Health Premium. Each one has specific limits and
exclusions.
This article must be interpreted together with the policy schedule and issued annexes.
Plan Scope Notes
Health Essential Coverage according to the benefits table Check current limits and sublimits
Health Complete Coverage according to the benefits table Check current limits and sublimits
Health Premium Coverage according to the benefits table Check current limits and sublimits
Support phones and deadlines are listed in the claims procedure for the line.

Demo Insurance General Conditions for Health Insurance
Article 5. General exclusions

This article must be interpreted together with the policy schedule and issued annexes.
Support phones and deadlines are listed in the claims procedure for the line.

Demo Insurance General Conditions for Health Insurance
Article 7. Claims
The policyholder must report the claim within 7 days after becoming aware of it and provide supporting
documentation.
This article must be interpreted together with the policy schedule and issued annexes.
Support phones and deadlines are listed in the claims procedure for the line.
